description: Employee Benefits Carrier Quote proposing voluntary or group coverage rates (AD&D, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, or Group Life), benefit design provisions, and broker commission schedules for a plan year. Where to read: Identified by carrier proposal cover pages, tiered employee rate tables (EE, EE+Spouse, EE+Children, Family), and Benefit Design Summary schedules. Distinguish from: Do NOT confuse with an employer's outbound Request for Proposal (`benefits-rfp`) or a commercial property & casualty placement quote (`commercial-property-quote`).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP). Where to read: Rate table column headers or proposal footer. Distinguish from: Return ISO 4217 code (USD, EUR, GBP), never raw currency symbols.

language.description: BCP-47 two-letter primary language tag of the document text (e.g. en, fr, de). Where to read: Inferred from the primary prose language of the quote. Distinguish from: Do NOT return country codes (US, GB) instead of language tags (en, fr, de).

premium.description: Headline premium amount in the quote's native currency exactly as printed. Where to read: Proposal Financial Summary box or Total Estimated Annual Premium line. Distinguish from: Do NOT sum per-tier unit rates yourself and do NOT extract broker commission amounts.

deductible.description: Deductible amount in the quote's native currency as printed. Where to read: Benefit Schedule / Deductible & Cost-Sharing row. Distinguish from: Do NOT confuse with out-of-pocket maximums or benefit coverage limits.

coverage_limits.description: Coverage limits or covered benefit maximums printed in the quote. Where to read: Schedule of Benefits ('Coverage Limits' / 'Maximum Benefit'). Distinguish from: Do NOT extract per-paycheck employee rate deductions.

exclusions.description: Excluded coverages, pre-existing condition limitations, or policy carve-outs. Where to read: Exclusions & Limitations section of the quote. Distinguish from: Do NOT fabricate exclusions when the document marks them absent.

effective_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the quoted plan takes effect. Where to read: Cover page or Proposal Summary ('Effective Date'). Distinguish from: Do NOT extract Quote Preparation Date or Rate Guarantee Expiry Date.

expiry_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the quote or rate guarantee expires. Where to read: Proposal validity footer or Rate Guarantee block. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the effective inception date.

product_line.description: Voluntary-benefit product line enum (AD_AND_D, CRITICAL_ILLNESS, HOSPITAL_INDEMNITY, LIFE). Where to read: Product header banner and Schedule of Benefits title. Distinguish from: Map strictly to one of AD_AND_D, CRITICAL_ILLNESS, HOSPITAL_INDEMNITY, or LIFE.

carrier_product_name.description: The carrier's own proprietary product name, verbatim as printed. Where to read: Cover banner or title block. Distinguish from: Preserve exact carrier branding rather than generic product line labels.

plan_year.description: 4-digit plan year the quote covers (e.g. 2027). Where to read: Cover page subtitle or Effective Date year. Distinguish from: Do NOT return full ISO dates when only the 4-digit year is requested.

commission_basis.description: Broker commission basis verbatim as printed (e.g. heaped, level). Where to read: Producer Compensation / Commission Schedule section. Distinguish from: Do NOT infer commission basis if omitted from the quote.

commission_rate_pct.description: Broker commission rate as a percentage text exactly as printed (e.g. 20). Where to read: Producer Compensation / Commission Schedule table. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract coinsurance percentages (e.g. 80/20 member cost share).

commission_notes.description: Any additional commission terms or grading notes, verbatim. Where to read: Footnotes beneath the Producer Compensation schedule. Distinguish from: Do NOT include general underwriting disclaimers unrelated to commissions.

plan_type.description: Plan design structure (e.g. HDHP, PPO, HMO, Group Life). Where to read: Schedule of Benefits header ('Plan: HDHP'). Distinguish from: When Plan == HDHP, linked tax-advantaged Employer Account Seed must be classified as HSA (Health Savings Account), never standard FSA.

employer_account_seed.description: Annual employer contribution to the employee tax-advantaged benefit account (e.g. $1,000.00). Where to read: Page 4 Schedule of Benefits ('Plan: HDHP · Employer Account Seed: $1,000.00'). Distinguish from: When the quoted plan is an HDHP (High Deductible Health Plan), Employer Account Seed is strictly an HSA (Part Of HDHP) and CANNOT be a standard Healthcare FSA (NOT Part Of HDHP).

waiting_period_days.description: Number of days a covered employee waits after a disability or benefit claim before benefits begin (e.g. 90 days). Where to read: Page 14 Schedule of Benefits or Policy Riders ('Elimination Period / Waiting Period: 90 Days'). Distinguish from: Do NOT confuse the 90-day Benefit Waiting Period on Page 14 with the 30-day New-Hire Enrollment Waiting Period on Page 2.

rates.description: one row per premium rate printed in the quote

coverage_tier.description: who the rate covers: employee, employee + spouse, employee + children, family

tobacco.description: tobacco rating class (UNI = unismoker / not distinguished)

amount.description: the rate exactly as printed, in the quote's native currency; never computed

frequency.description: billing frequency the rate amount is expressed in, per row (carriers mix them)

rate_basis.description: FLAT premium, per $1,000 of benefit, or per unit of benefit

benefit_amount.description: benefit amount the rate is priced at, as printed

design.description: one row per benefit-design provision printed in the quote

category.description: the benefit provision, in standard terms where obvious (e.g. Heart Attack)

category_original.description: the carrier's own term for the provision, verbatim

value.description: the provision's value as printed (e.g. $10,000, 6 months, Yes)
